title: Run a setup method
summary: Spring Framework: Run a setup method. Change the setup text.
introduction: initMethod names a method Spring calls after making the bean.
learningObjectives: Run a setup method with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Run a setup method

blocks.text: Spring calls prepare after construction. That method stores Ready before the program reads text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The named method must exist and be callable with no arguments.
